fixture_correction.cause: A normal TCP FIN may be a valid write-half-close while the client still waits for a response. The first cancellation fixture did not send a reset.
fixture_correction.change: Use SO_LINGER(1,0) to generate a real TCP reset. Keep the original cancellation deadline, zero-POST and credential-preservation assertions.
